   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 6, 2026 - Aug 8, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Storm Grimmery_, Aug 7, 2026, 1/5: "The ads are too much for me. The reply is so slow. The quality isn't good."
            2. _Lauri 13_, Aug 7, 2026, 1/5: "Making the swipes for new generated messages limited makes the app even more unusable than it already is! And waiting 11+ hours to be able to swipe again? Seriously?! You guys don’t even think about the people who can‘t spend so much money monthly or don’t want to because the price is ridiculously high do you?!!"
            3. _ChaosMeow:3_, Aug 4, 2026, 1/5: "I’ve discovered this app about 2 years ago. It genuinely helped me with my anxiety and in times I felt down. It was genuinely good but now it’s just. Meh. So many adds I think that most of my time on this app is watching apps. I mean at first it wasn’t to bad. Annoying that every 5th bot I opened i got an add. Could look over that but now every single bot I try to open I have to watch an add. In chats I have to use adds and there are adds on the screen in the chat. It genuinely feels like a cheap stupid phone game that you’ll see 5000 adds about in one day. This app WAS good but all those updates are killing it. Edit: It’s getting worse. Now you have a limit amount to swipe for responses for bots that are literally HORRIBLE. They either speak for you when they shouldn’t, COMPLETELY CHANGE THE TOPIC or just in general say total gibberish. I’d genuinely would give it -4 stars at this point. Why not -6? Cause it was good. it WAS. But they are literally money hungry and they are gonna make it worse and worse and worse for people that use it for free till it’s absolutely unusable unless you pay those 10 Euros a month or 119 Euros a year. Like cmon. How can such a good app go down so bad. Like ok adds, they are annoying and so but AT LEAST DONT MAKE PEOPLE PAY FOR BASIC STUFF THEN. Oh my god. I’m genuinely disappointed and at this point even disgusted by how bad an app can go down. It definitely didn’t deserve those 4 stars it has."
